patthana21.47:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ.
patthana21.47:2.1: na anāsavaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ (gaṇitakena tīṇi,) na sāsavaṃ na anidassana
patthana21.47:4.1: na anāsavaṃ na anidassana appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo anidassana appaṭigho
